Class ClipRecord

java.lang.Object
org.roux.session.ClipRecord
public final class ClipRecord extends Object
The ClipRecord is the 64-byte file named clip.bin. The file sits beside manifest.bin. The record stores the head origin for the next prompt. An absent file means the next prompt uses the present walk. A checksum miss means the same walk. The magic bytes are C, L, I, and P. The version is 1. The checksum covers bytes 0 through 39. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#ClipRecord roux-plan-clip.001.md

  • Method Details

    • auto

      public static ClipRecord auto(long origin, int capacity, int estimate, int remaining, long epochMs)
      The method builds a live auto record. Bit 0 is set. Bit 1 is clear.
      Parameters:
      origin - The origin is the head sequence, or 0 when there is no floor.
      capacity - The capacity is the token window, or 0.
      estimate - The estimate is the token count of the head.
      remaining - The remaining count is the unused capacity.
      epochMs - The epoch is the roll time in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The record is the live auto clip.

    • rewind

      public static ClipRecord rewind(long origin, int capacity, int estimate, int remaining, long epochMs)

      Parameters:
      origin - The origin is the rewind sequence.
      capacity - The capacity is the token window, or 0.
      estimate - The estimate is the token count of the head.
      remaining - The remaining count is the unused capacity.
      epochMs - The epoch is the rewind time in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The record is the live rewind clip.

    • read

      public static ClipRecord read(Path dir)
      The method reads clip.bin. An absent file returns null. A short file, a wrong magic, a wrong version, or a checksum miss returns null.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      Returns:
      The record is the clip, or null when the file is absent or unread.

    • write

      public static void write(Path dir, ClipRecord record) throws IOException
      The method writes clip.bin. The directory is created when it is absent. The bytes go to clip.bin.tmp, the channel is forced, and the temp file replaces the destination. A failed atomic move deletes the destination and moves the temp file again. The origin long sits at offset 12 and is stored without an eight-byte alignment.
      Parameters:
      dir - The directory is the region directory.
      record - The record is the clip to write.
      Throws:
      IOException - The write or the move failed.
